categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Modifies ci/test/03_test_script.sh and related CI setup scripts to add tcpdump network traffic monitoring.
categories.rationale: Adds automated tcpdump checks to CI scripts to detect unexpected outbound network or DNS traffic generated during test runs. While helpful for ensuring test hermeticity and preventing flakiness or data leaks, it is an incremental CI validation enhancement rather than a fix for broken builds or CI unreliability.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Carries the Tests label and introduces an infrastructure-level check across all test stages to enforce test hermeticity.
categories.rationale: Enforces network hermeticity across the test suite by failing CI if tests emit outbound packets on non-loopback interfaces. This prevents inadvertent external dependencies and DNS leaks in test execution, providing valuable but reasonably deferrable infrastructure protection.
